name: bu_Ga8O12
title: Ga2O3 (Ga8O12) crystal
description: Crystal structure prediction of Ga2O3 with 4 formula units (20 atoms) per cell. The experimental ground state beta-Ga2O3 (C2/m, half tetrahedral and half octahedral Ga; this cell is twice its primitive cell) is also the NEP89 global minimum; corundum-type alpha-Ga2O3 (+28.7 meV/atom with NEP89) is a deep competing funnel (the mirror image of bu_Al8O12, where corundum is the ground state and the beta-Ga2O3 type is the trap).
